"'''[[Gold Four]]'''" was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[pilot]] who flew in [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]] in the [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire|early rebellion]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[2 BBY]], he and his fellow pilots escorted [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]]'s shuttle ''[[Chandrila Mistress]]'' into hiding. After rendezvousing with the [[Spectres]] rebel cell's starship ''[[Ghost]]'', the rebels traveled through the dangerous [[Archeon pass]]. During the journey, Gold Four and his comrade [[Tyson (Gold Squadron)|Gold Three]] were shot down by an Imperial [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Defender]].

==Biography==
Gold Four was a member of [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]], which flew [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber|Y-wings]] as part of the rebellion. In [[2 BBY]], Gold Four and his fellow Gold Squadron fliers escorted [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]]'s [[shuttle]] ''[[Chandrila Mistress]]'' into hiding. Mothma had incurred the wrath of the [[Galactic Empire]] by denouncing the [[Darth Sidious|Emperor's]] role in the [[Ghorman Massacre]]. Gold Four and his fellow pilots rendezvoused with the [[Spectres]] in deep space.<ref name="Secret Cargo" />

Gold Four and his fellow pilots refueled their Y-wings with the Spectres' starship ''[[Ghost]]''. Gold Squadron, who were joined by the Spectres rebel [[Ezra Bridger]], then took part in a brief dogfight with Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] and an [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]]. Gold Squadron disabled the light cruiser with [[ion cannon]]s before bombing the ship. At the advice of the Spectres' leader [[Hera Syndulla]], the rebels then traveled through the [[Archeon Nebula]] in order to reach [[Dantooine]] where Mon Mothma planned to attend an important meeting.<ref name="Secret Cargo" />

While traveling through the [[Archeon pass]], the rebel convoy was pursued by a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Defender]] piloted by [[Commander]] [[Vult Skerris]] and two [[TIE/IN interceptor|TIE interceptors]]. [[Gold Leader]] [[Jon Vander]] sent Gold Four and [[Tyson (Gold Squadron)|Gold Three]] to intercept the Imperial fighters. However, Skerris quickly destroyed both starfighters. Following a [[Operation Handoff|skirmish]], the rebels and Mon Mothma managed to reach Dantooine where they formed the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Secret Cargo" />

==Personality and traits==
Gold Four was a rebel starfighter pilot who flew a Y-wing starfighter as part of Gold Squadron. He had blue eyes, brown hair, and fair skin. Gold Four was a competent pilot but was no match for Vult Skerris' TIE Defender.<ref name="Secret Cargo" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gold Four first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|Season Three]] episode "[[Secret Cargo]]," which premiered on [[March 4]], [[2017]]. He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who also voiced [[Admiral]] [[Kassius Konstantine]] and the [[Clone trooper]]s.
